back: Two taxi fares, ₹50 + ₹10/km and ₹20 + ₹15/km, cost the same at 6 km. The crossing point answers both equations.

title: Three things two lines can do
back: Intersect: one solution. Parallel: none. Coincide: infinitely many.

title: One solution
back: Different slopes: the lines intersect. The pair is consistent.

title: No solution
back: Same slope, different start: parallel lines. The pair is inconsistent.

title: Infinitely many solutions
back: The two equations are the same line. Consistent and dependent.

title: Elimination method
back: Same signs subtract; different signs add. Then substitute back and check.

title: A two-digit number
back: Reversing the digits gives $10y+x$. Their difference is always $9(x-y)$.

title: Boat and stream
back: With the current the speeds add; against it they subtract. Time = distance ÷ speed.

title: Fixed charge plus rate
back: Taxi fares, library fines, hostel charges: two bills give two equations.
